svg.aria-label: On the way home. Gantry leaves first. Kaveri follows with the covered assembly; later, thoughts turn to home.

svg.title: On the way home
svg.desc: Page 7: On the way home. Back inside Kaveri, Rina and Samir finish the restraint and access checks after the assembly has been clamped into the external cradle. The display confirms the load; they do not stand outside without suits. Through the window, Gantry leaves first, intact. No threatening shape watches it depart, and no departure interval is printed. Kaveri outbound from Aquila, with the same covered assembly visible in its external cradle. A quiet, wider panel with the town falling behind. No dialogue. No promise that the next panel is only moments later. Later in the return leg. Leila checks the load record near Jonah. The work is under control, and her attention can briefly return to home.

svg.text: PRIVATE COMIC DRAFT / DESIGNS AND DIALOGUE PROVISIONAL
